Class Florida_Dental

java.lang.Object
Florida_Dental
public class Florida_Dental extends Object
The Florida Dental program meant to take in, store, and modify dental information of given family members. Can be used to store incisors, bicuspids, and missing teeth for each individual. Once completed, each individual record can be printed, have teeth extracted, or report the families root canal indices through using the equation Ix^2+Bx-M.

    • getFamilySize

      public static int getFamilySize()
      getFamilySize() method is used to get the number of family members that can be no more than 6 and no less than 1. It will then use the size to collect the dental data for each individual in the family.
      Returns:
      the size of the family to be used for data collection.

    • getFamilyRecords

      public static void getFamilyRecords(String[] famNames, char[][][] famTeeth)
      The getFamilyRecords method is used to gather the data for the family dental information. This includes the famNames of the family members and the famTeeth for each family member on both the upper and lower jaws.
      Parameters:
      famNames -
      famTeeth -

    • isRecordValid

      public static int isRecordValid(String famRecord)
      This method is used to determine whether the entered teeth are valid for the famRecord. This is done by checking to see whether each character in the famRecord is either B,I, or M. If the character is not one of the following, the method sends an error and allows the user to retry.
      Parameters:
      famRecord - : The previously entered characters that represent each tooth of the individual family members.
      Returns:
      valid: if the characters are valid, the program will continue, and the loop will make the user try again if it is not.

    • displayMenu

      public static void displayMenu()
      The displayMenu method is used to display the menu options after all the family record input values have been taken. The options provided to the user are print, extract, roots, and exit. The method uses previously declared constants for each function.

    • printRecords

      public static void printRecords(String[] famNames, char[][][] famTeeth)
      This method is used to display the family records. This method displays each family member's name with their respective teeth at the position for both the upper and lower jaws.
      Parameters:
      famNames - This parameter uses the previous array for the names of each family member to display the names.
      famTeeth - This parameter uses the previous array for the teeth of the family records to display the teeth for each family member.

    • editTooth

      public static void editTooth(String[] famNames, char[][][] famTeeth)
      This method is used to extract a tooth of a specific family member at a specific position. This method will update the record so that the extracted tooth will now be marked as missing for the family member
      Parameters:
      famNames - This parameter is used to find the name of the family member in the array and take the correct data corresponding to the array for the teeth.
      famTeeth - This parameter is used to find the teeth at the designated position to then extract it (replace I or B with M at a certatin position).

    • calculateRoots

      public static void calculateRoots(char[][][] famTeeth)
      This method analyses the root canal indices by calculating the roots of the data using the equation Ix^2 + Bx - M. The method then reports both of the roots of the calculations. This method includes the following cases: two possible roots, one possible root, and no possible roots.
      Parameters:
      famTeeth - The famTeeth parameter is used since the data required to find the roots is present within the three-dimensional array famTeethm.
